Definition
[Riesz potential] 1. ch7:7.31\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0171 For $0<\mu \leq 1$ and $f\in L^1(\Omega )$, define \begin{equation} \tag {7.31} (V_\mu f)(x)=\int _\Omega |x-y|^{n(\mu -1)}f(y)\, dy. \end{equation}
